claim: The Testcontainers Mosquitto module provides a Rust API for launching a throwaway Eclipse Mosquitto MQTT broker in tests with a single start() call, with the broker URL derived from the container's host and mapped port 1883.
stance_target: ha-linux-agent can be made reliable by adding ephemeral-broker MQTT integration tests instead of relying on untested live-broker code paths
scope_conditions: Rust test code with the testcontainers-modules 'mosquitto' feature; requires Docker at test time
quoted_support: Dependency: cargo add -F mosquitto --dev testcontainers-modules — Usage: testcontainers_modules::mosquitto::Mosquitto::default().start() ... let broker_url = format!("{}:{}", mosquitto_instance.get_host().unwrap(), mosquitto_instance.get_host_port_ipv4(1883).unwrap());

claim: The Mosquitto Testcontainers module is community-maintained, outside the core Testcontainers project.
stance_target: assessment of how well-supported the Rust MQTT test tooling is
quoted_support: These modules are maintained by the community, outside of the Testcontainers project.
